name: Mobile login returns token + user
expected: HTTP 200. { token, user:{ id, role } }. Token stored in AsyncStorage.

name: Bearer token attached to subsequent requests
steps: Request interceptor reads AsyncStorage 'token' and sets Authorization header. Call GET /api/users/me with it.
expected: HTTP 200 with the caller's profile.

name: authService.getProfile() route
expected: HTTP 200 with profile.

name: Register a citizen from mobile
expected: HTTP 201 { message, userId }.

name: Wrong password rejected
expected: HTTP 401. App shows an inline error, does not navigate.

name: Google sign-in endpoint reachable
expected: Endpoint exists. HTTP 400/401 for an invalid idToken (not 404/500).

name: Invalid / expired JWT forces logout
steps: GET a protected route with a forged token
expected: HTTP 401. App clears token+user and returns to Login.

name: ngrok HTML interstitial guarded
steps: Response interceptor: if content-type is text/html → reject with a clear error
expected: JSON.parse never runs on HTML; user sees 'tunnel may not be running'.

name: Dashboard stats contract
expected: HTTP 200, object with incident / alert / water counts.

name: Recent alerts feed
expected: HTTP 200, array; each item has id, title, message, type.

name: My reports list
expected: HTTP 200, array scoped to the caller.

name: Notifications feed
expected: HTTP 200, array of notifications.

name: Report an incident (online)
steps: incidentService.report({ title, description, category, location, latitude, longitude })
expected: HTTP 201, incident id returned, status PENDING.

name: Report incident with base64 photo evidence
expected: HTTP 201; images accepted (stored / referenced).

name: SOS panic trigger
expected: HTTP 200/201; a high-priority incident / SOS record is created.

name: Voice report (speech-to-text)
steps: VoiceReport component uses expo-speech / mic on device
expected: Transcribed text populates the description field.

name: GPS location auto-fill in report form
steps: LocationPicker reads expo-location; lat/lng go into the payload
expected: Backend accepts and stores the coordinates from the device.

name: Report incident while offline → queued
expected: Row inserted into SQLite sync_queue with status 'pending'; UI shows 'queued'.

name: useOfflineSubmit — 2xx is success, not queued
steps: Submit with a reachable server and valid data
expected: status 'success'; nothing added to the queue.

name: useOfflineSubmit — 4xx surfaced, not queued
expected: status 'error', message shown; NOT queued (permanent failure).

name: useOfflineSubmit — network failure is queued
steps: Submit with the server unreachable / request timeout (8s)
expected: status 'queued'; item persisted for later retry.

name: Sync-queue table schema
steps: localDB setupTables creates sync_queue (id, type, payload, status, attempts, max_attempts, created_at, synced_at, error_msg)
expected: Table + columns match; default status 'pending', max_attempts 5.

name: Sync handler map covers all queued types
steps: syncService.SYNC_HANDLERS has an entry for every type useOfflineSubmit / screens enqueue
expected: INCIDENT_REPORT, HELP_REQUEST, DAMAGE_ASSESSMENT, TASK_STATUS_UPDATE, RELIEF_TOKEN_CLAIM, MISSING_PERSON_REPORT, RESOURCE_SUBMISSION, DONATION_SUBMIT, FAMILY_SAFETY_UPDATE, SOS_PANIC, REPORT_VERIFICATION, PSYCHOLOGICAL_SUPPORT all mapped.

name: Backend accepts X-Offline-Sync header
steps: POST /api/incidents with header X-Offline-Sync: true + X-Original-Timestamp
expected: HTTP 201; request processed normally, extra headers ignored / honoured.

name: markFailed retry / max-attempts logic
steps: markFailed increments attempts; status flips to 'failed' once attempts >= max_attempts
expected: Item stops being retried after 5 attempts.

name: getPendingItems excludes maxed / failed items
steps: SELECT ... WHERE status='pending' AND attempts < max_attempts ORDER BY created_at ASC
expected: FIFO order; failed and exhausted items not returned.

name: Reconnect (ideal) — queue drains 100%
steps: Queue 10 / 50 / 100 items, restore connectivity, run syncPendingItems
expected: 100% success, 0% data loss (per offline_sync_results.json).

name: Disconnect mid-sync — no data loss
steps: Drop the connection while a 50-item queue is syncing
expected: Partial success (~77%); remaining items stay 'pending'; 0% data loss.

name: App restart — queue persists and drains
steps: Kill the app with 50 queued items, relaunch, reconnect
expected: SQLite queue survives; 100% eventually synced, 0% loss.

name: Duplicate on retry
steps: Force a retry of an item the server already accepted (F. Duplicate Retry scenario)
expected: No duplicate server records should be created.

name: Packet loss resilience
steps: Sync a 50-item queue under 5% / 10% / 20% packet loss
expected: Failures degrade gracefully (~4% / 12% / 24%); failed items remain retryable; 0% data loss.

name: haversineKm distance accuracy
expected: ≈ 94 km (90–98 km); symmetric; 0 for identical points.

name: isAlertNearby — All Island broadcasts to everyone
expected: Returns true regardless of user coordinates.

name: isAlertNearby — within / outside broadcast radius
steps: Alert with coords + radius; user inside vs far away
expected: true when within radius (default 10 km), false when outside.

name: isAlertNearby — no coords, not All-Island → hidden
steps: Alert with empty latitudes and no 'All Island' tag
expected: Returns false (not shown until coordinates are set).

name: isWithinRadius — missing coords shows the item
expected: Returns true (no location → don't filter out).

name: Nearby safe zones contract
expected: HTTP 200; array/GeoJSON of nearby places.

name: River levels contract
expected: HTTP 200, array with gaugeId, waterLevelMetres, status, district.

name: Predictions contract + latency
expected: HTTP 200 within the app's 10 s axios timeout; array with prediction objects.

name: Rainfall data contract
expected: HTTP 200, array of rainfall readings.

name: Get my family status
expected: HTTP 200 with the caller's family + statuses.

name: Report 'I am safe'
expected: HTTP 200/201; status recorded and broadcast to linked members.

name: Add a family member
expected: HTTP 201; member linked to the account.

name: My relief tokens
expected: HTTP 200, array of the caller's tokens.

name: Claim a relief token (QR)
expected: HTTP 200 for a valid ACTIVE token; 4xx for invalid / expired / used.

name: QR code scanning
steps: ReliefTokenScreen uses expo-camera to read a token QR
expected: Scanned code is passed to claimToken.

name: Relief camps (with offline cache)
steps: campService.getCamps() → GET /api/camps; result cached to relief_camps_cache
expected: HTTP 200; array; cached rows readable when offline.

name: Public missing persons list
expected: HTTP 200, array.

name: Create a help request
steps: helpRequestService.createRequest({ type, description, location, latitude, longitude })
expected: HTTP 201; request created with status PENDING.

name: My supply requests
expected: HTTP 200, array scoped to the caller.

name: Volunteer — my tasks
expected: HTTP 200, array of tasks for the volunteer.

name: Submit a donation
expected: HTTP 201; donation recorded.

name: Damage assessment submit + list
expected: POST 201, GET 200 array.

name: Operational intelligence feed
expected: HTTP 200 (or 403 if role-gated); no 404/500.

name: Log device location
expected: HTTP 200/201; location stored, user sector updated.

name: Push notification token registration
expected: Returns an Expo push token; posts it to the backend. (Expo Go returns undefined — documented.)

name: Local notification display
expected: Banner shows while the app is open (works in Expo Go and builds).

name: Location permission gate
steps: LocationGateScreen requests foreground location permission on first launch
expected: App blocks the main tabs until permission is granted or skipped.

name: Camera permission for evidence / QR
expected: Denied → graceful message; granted → capture works.

name: Background sync task
steps: expo-background-fetch + expo-task-manager registered; fires syncPendingItems periodically
expected: Queue drains in the background without opening the app.

name: SQLite offline DB opens & seeds
expected: DB created once; emergency numbers + first-aid guides available offline.

name: Maps render (react-native-maps)
steps: SafeZoneScreen / WaterLevelScreen render a MapView with markers
expected: Map tiles + markers render on device.

name: Three languages load
steps: i18n/index.ts registers en / si / ta; LanguageScreen switches
expected: UI strings switch; missing keys fall back to English.

name: API + socket base URLs configured
steps: config.ts exports API_BASE_URL (…/api) and SOCKET_URL (ngrok static domains)
expected: Both point at reachable hosts; API_BASE_URL ends with /api.

name: Token storage location
steps: Where the JWT is persisted after login
expected: Stored in a secure store (expo-secure-store) rather than plain AsyncStorage.

name: Socket.IO connects for live alerts
steps: services/socket.ts connects to SOCKET_URL; listens for 'new-alert'
expected: Connection established; new-alert events trigger a local notification.

name: Offline banner reflects connectivity
steps: networkMonitor polls every 8 s; OfflineBanner shows when isConnected is false
expected: Banner appears within ~8 s of losing the link, hides on restore, triggers a sync.

name: Role-based tab set after login
steps: navigation reads stored user.role; VOLUNTEER / FIELD_RESPONDER get the Tasks tab
expected: Citizen sees citizen tabs; volunteer sees the extra Tasks tab.
